offering_description.value: Develops and sells software and services for communications service providers and media companies, including billing, customer management, network operations and digital media systems. Delivers them through licenses, cloud subscriptions, system integration and outsourced managed operations.

primary_products.value: billing and customer management software; network and service orchestration software; digital media software; customer engagement software; telecom analytics software

primary_services.value: system integration; managed IT and network operations; consulting; cloud migration; application maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: telecom operators, cable and broadband providers, media and entertainment companies

end_markets.value: telecommunications; media and entertainment; cable and broadband; utilities

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: software licenses sold to communications and media providers; subscription: cloud-hosted software subscriptions; service fees: managed operations and support services; project or contract: multi-year integration and transformation contracts
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; subscription; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: takes in engineering and product development, sells software platforms to telecom and media operators; service provider: takes in staff and delivery expertise, sells outsourced operations and integration services to operators

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America, Israel and other regions with telecom operators

specialization.value: related lines: billing and customer management, network and service management, digital media software, managed services for telecom customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams selling to telecom and media operators; partners / resellers: systems integrators and technology partners that help deliver projects

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and security rules such as GDPR, plus telecom customer data and network security requirements
